haiku-low.q1: Sign-in still works: the linked sub matches directly and signs them in. Email is not compared, and Google never changes users.email.
haiku-low.q2: The user must enter that account's correct password on the confirm page; only then is the link made and a session started.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password adds to failed_logins; at 5 the account locks 15 minutes and the pending link is deleted. Otherwise the form reappears.
haiku-low.q4: Verified email with no match: a new user is created with NULL password, linked, and signed in. Unverified email: refused, back to /login with a use-email-and-password message; nothing created.
haiku-low.q5: Error page: invalid or expired link, link to /login, nothing changed. The state expired or was consumed, so GETDEL finds nothing.
haiku-low.q6: A new sessions row via start_session. Any existing sid row for this browser is deleted, and the sid cookie is replaced with the new session id.
haiku-low.q7: Neither a password nor an email match is required. If the Google account is linked to another user, Settings refuses and nothing changes.
haiku-low.q8: In Redis key goauth:state:<state> (code_verifier, nonce, mode, user_id, next), 600 s TTL; state is in the oidc_state cookie. Removed by the callback's atomic GETDEL or TTL expiry.
haiku-low.q9: Held in Redis key goauth:pending:<token> (sub, user_id, next). The browser refers to it by the random token in the oidc_pending cookie. Deleted on success, lockout, refusal, new attempt, or 600 s TTL.
haiku-low.q10: In PostgreSQL table user_google_accounts. user_id is the primary key (one Google account per user); sub is UNIQUE (one user per Google account).
haiku-low.q11: Back to the start page: 'Google sign-in did not work, try again or use email and password'. Not retried; the state is consumed, so the user starts again.
haiku-low.q12: The state record stores mode (login or link) and, for link, user_id. The callback checks the current session's user equals the stored user_id; otherwise it shows the error page.

sonnet.q1: Nothing changes: accounts are identified only by `sub`, which never changes, and Google's email is never stored or compared for a linked sub. The linked `sub` signs in directly via start_session.
sonnet.q2: (Unlinked sub, verified email matching an existing user with no other Google account.) A pending record and oidc_pending cookie are created and the user is sent to the confirm page. They must enter that account's correct password (not locked). Then user_google_accounts is inserted, pending is deleted, and start_session runs.
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins and the confirm page is shown again (pending stays until TTL). At 5, locked_until = now + 15 min and failed_logins resets to 0. The pending record and cookie are deleted, the user goes back to /login with 'Account temporarily locked', and the link is discarded.
sonnet.q4: Verified email matching no user: in one transaction a new user is inserted (lowercased email, NULL password_hash, email_verified_at now) plus a user_google_accounts row, then start_session. Unverified email (sub not linked): refused, back to /login with a message to use email and password; nothing created.
sonnet.q5: Both cases: the state is unknown/expired (over 10 min) or already used (GETDEL), so the error page is shown (link to /login) and nothing changes.
sonnet.q6: It calls the existing start_session, so a normal sessions row (no new session type) is inserted and the sid cookie is set. If the browser had a sid cookie, that sessions row is deleted first (no-op if none). Then redirect to next if a relative path, else /home.
sonnet.q7: No password and no email match is required (emails need not match); it needs a signed-in session and CSRF token, and no session is started. If the Google sub is linked to another user, Settings refuses with 'This Google account is linked to another user' and nothing changes.
sonnet.q8: State, nonce, mode, code_verifier (plus user_id in link mode, next) are in Redis key goauth:state:<state> with EX 600; the state value is also in the oidc_state cookie. The callback's atomic GETDEL removes the Redis record (single use), otherwise the TTL does. The oidc_state cookie is cleared at the start of the callback on every outcome.
sonnet.q9: In Redis key goauth:pending:<token> holding sub, matched user_id and next, with EX 600. The browser refers to it by the oidc_pending cookie containing the random token. It is deleted on successful link, lockout, refusal, a new Google attempt in the same browser, or the 10 minute TTL; the cookie is cleared with it.
sonnet.q10: In the PostgreSQL table user_google_accounts (user_id, sub, linked_at). user_id is the PRIMARY KEY (one Google account per user, FK to users with ON DELETE CASCADE) and sub is NOT NULL UNIQUE (one user per Google account).
sonnet.q11: The user is returned to the start page (/login keeping next, or /settings) with a message that Google sign-in did not work, try again or use email and password. Nothing changes and the reason is logged. It is not retried (5 s timeout, no retry), and the same state cannot be reused; the user must start again.
sonnet.q12: By the `mode` (login or link) stored in the Redis state record at start. For link mode the state record also stores user_id (the current user); the callback requires a current session whose user equals that stored user_id, otherwise it shows the error page. The link is then made for that stored user.
